channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, Canada, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, Canada, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Alberta Foundation for the Arts: Visual Arts and New Media Individual Project Funding (March 2027)
item.description: Alberta Foundation for the Arts · deadline 01 Mar 2027 · Up to CAD 18,000 per project. No application fee.

item.title: Ontario Arts Council: Media Artists Creation Projects (October 2026 deadline)
item.description: Ontario Arts Council · deadline 08 Oct 2026 · Emerging: maximum CAD 10,000; Mid-Career and Established: maximum CAD 40,000. No application fee.

item.title: Manitoba Arts Council: Create Grant (October 2026 intake)
item.description: Manitoba Arts Council · deadline 10 Oct 2026 · Emerging: up to CAD 7,500; Mid-career: up to CAD 10,000; Established: up to CAD 15,000. No application fee.

item.title: Struts Gallery: Open Studio Residency Program 2027 (Sackville, New Brunswick)
item.description: Struts Gallery · deadline 19 Oct 2026 · CAD 3,250 artist fee, CAD 30 per diem (CAD 750 total for 25 working days), travel costs up to CAD 800, and CAD 200 towards materials for workshops or other public events. Residents also get 24-hour access to a roughly 400 sq ft studio, a private furnished two-bedroom apartment above the gallery, and access to the centre's media arts equipment and facilities.

item.title: Est-Nord-Est Artist Residency 2027-2028 (Saint-Jean-Port-Joli, Quebec)
item.description: Est-Nord-Est, residence d'artistes · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · CAD 2,080 residency honorarium, plus a free individual studio-workshop with lodging, access to specialized wood, metal and ceramics equipment, a documentation center, and technical, artistic and logistical support. Four artists per session. No application fee.

item.title: SAT: Research-Creation Residency Program in Arts and Technologies 2026-28 (Montreal)
item.description: Societe des arts technologiques (SAT) · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · CAD 10,000 grant per selected project, for individual artists and collectives alike. Also included: access to SAT workspaces during the residency periods, access to equipment and software resources subject to availability, mentoring and training activities (on site and remote), creative and technical support from the SAT teams, and documentation and archiving of the work. Travel, meals and accommodation beyond the grant are NOT covered. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• AI Builders Fellowship 2026 (Internet Archive Canada x BC + AI)
    https://bc-ai.ca/fellowship
    Internet Archive Canada (IAC) in partnership with BC + AI · deadline 21 Aug 2026 · $5,000 award for one selected builder. No application fee.
  • Video Pool: Media Art + Technology Residency (MATR) 2027
    https://videopool.org/media-arts-technology-residency-2027-call-for-applications/
    Video Pool Media Arts Centre · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · CAD 2,250 artist fee, covering both the residency period and the subsequent Poolside Gallery exhibition. Residents also get full access to VP's equipment, facilities and technical resources; the Poolside Gallery itself is equipped with two projectors and four speakers. Applicants must be VP members, so a membership is purchased separately, but there is no separate application fee.

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Inside Out RE:Focus Fund Post-Production Grants 2026
    https://insideout.ca/initiatives/re-focus-fund/
    Inside Out (Toronto 2SLGBTQ+ Film Festival) · deadline 22 Jul 2026 · Post-production grant funding to support the completion and promotion of short and feature films; the requested amount is set by the applicant (see the FAQ 'How much funding can I request?'). Since 2018 the RE:Focus Fund has distributed more than CAD 300,000 in grants and programs. No application fee.
  • Black Arts Centre: Call for Exhibition and Programming Proposals
    https://theblackartscentre.ca/submissions/
    Black Arts Centre · deadline 08 Aug 2026 · Successful proposals receive financial, budgeting, and curatorial support from the Black Arts Centre, including project execution, production, logistics, and marketing. No submission fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Call to Artists: Walden Fire Station and Library (Calgary Arts Development)
    https://calgaryartsdevelopment.com/public-art/opportunities/all/call-to-artists-walden-fire-station-and-library/
    Calgary Arts Development (CADA) · deadline 28 Jul 2026 · Total project budget of CAD 275,000 (exclusive of all applicable taxes) for one selected artist/artist team. The artist fee for the total project is CAD 68,750 + GST. Budget breakdown can be adapted to the artist's approach, following CARFAC's recommendation that a minimum 20% of the budget go to the artist's fee; the total allocated budget will not be increased.
